row.stop_reason: Exercise (activity) is completely aliased with study batch: all sedentary samples (NP_1-3, HP_1-3) are reused from GSE120958, a separate 2019 cohort (12-week HPD, different age/protocol), and all exercised samples (NPE, HPE) were sequenced for GSE325957 by Plasmidsaurus (S2.8.p1, S9.p1, S2.1.p1, S1.p2). No sample of either activity level exists in the other batch, so the exercise effect cannot be separated from cohort, library preparation, sequencing run, mouse age and diet duration. The paper's own PCA (S3.7.p1: exercised vs sedentary 'vastly different', exercised diets similar) is what a batch split would also produce. Refused at covariance; no model can identify the estimand from these data.
